projects.name: Catalyst
projects.tagline: One home for movies and series.
projects.description: A native app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Discover what to watch, keep your place across devices, and play from the sources you already use.
highlights: Home, arranged your way
Built-in player, or the one you prefer
Your place synced with Trakt and CataSync
Media servers and Stremio add-ons

screenshots.alt: Home on iPhone with Slow Horses in the hero, a new-episode badge, Go to Show, and Continue Watching above the tab bar.
The page for Rogue One: A Star Wars Story on iPhone, with Start Watching, genres, synopsis, runtime, rating and trailers.
The Library on iPhone: watch plans for the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Star Wars, Coming Soon and History.
Settings on iPhone: Customize Home, Appearance, Automatic Previews, Discovery and Library, Video Player, Playback Source and Providers.
Catalyst on iPad showing Nosferatu (1922), with the profile in the native sidebar and shelves of classic films.
Catalyst on iPad showing The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), with synopsis, playback controls, details and recommendations.

The page for Project Hail Mary on Mac, with Rewatch, download and watched buttons, the cast, and a rating prompt.
Your year in film on Mac: hours watched, films, viewings, repeat viewings and TV episodes, with a month-by-month chart.

The page for Sinners (2025) on Apple TV, with genres, synopsis, runtime, rating, cast and a Start Watching button.

projects.name: Hangar
projects.tagline: Every Steam account, one click away.
projects.description: Changes the signed-in Steam account without the account picker or a password prompt, and shows every game on every account.
highlights: Silent switching, straight to the tray
Play as… launches a game on the account that owns it
Your whole library, installed or not
Never reads or stores passwords

screenshots.alt: Home with a featured game, playtime and Continue Playing for the signed-in account.
Installed games in a grid of Steam cover art, with playtime for each.
Three remembered Steam accounts, each with a Switch button, and Add Account.

projects.name: Verdant
projects.description: Finds the latest Game Ready and Studio drivers for your NVIDIA card, checks they're genuine and installs them with one prompt.
highlights: Matches your exact card with NVIDIA's catalog
Only runs installers signed by NVIDIA
Express or custom install, with roll back
Live GPU temperature, load and VRAM

screenshots.alt: Home with the latest Game Ready driver, 621.14, installed and up to date.
Every Game Ready driver for a GeForce RTX 2060, with the installed one marked and roll back for the rest.
My GPU: live temperature, load, video memory, power, clock and fan speed, with driver and hardware details.

projects.name: Keepsake
projects.tagline: Your emulator saves, in one place.
projects.description: Finds your RPCS3 and Lichii games and every save, starts any game straight from its library, and edits the saves of supported games with each game's own artwork.
highlights: RPCS3 and Lichii in one library
Play without the emulator's game list
Save editors for LEGO Batman and LEGO Indiana Jones
A backup before every change
projects.note: Not affiliated with the RPCS3 or Lichii projects, Nintendo, Sony, Warner Bros. Games, TT Games or the LEGO Group.

screenshots.alt: Home with LEGO Batman in the hero: Play, Edit Save, 88.9% complete, and Recently Saved games from RPCS3 and Lichii.
Games in a grid: games with saves first, then PlayStation 3 and Switch games with no saves yet.
Editing a LEGO Batman save: studs, levels, Mini-kits, Red Power Bricks, characters, vehicles, Extras, suit upgrades and Batman facts.
The Batcomputer roster with each character’s portrait and price, bought or locked.
LEGO Indiana Jones levels: story, parcel, 100% flags and Artefacts for each level of Raiders of the Lost Ark.

projects.name: Prism
projects.tagline: Your games, in their own colours.
projects.description: Gives every game its own vibrance, contrast and white balance, switched on when the game takes focus and off when you leave it. Works on any graphics card.
highlights: Switches with the game in focus
Vibrance up to 200%, past the driver
NVIDIA, AMD and Intel, no admin rights
About 2 MB in the tray
projects.note: Based on Digital Vibrance by SYTStudio. Not affiliated with NVIDIA, AMD or Intel.

screenshots.alt: Home with FragPunk active at 200% vibrance, the colours on screen, and a shelf of game profiles.
Games in a grid, each with its own icon and vibrance.
Editing the Counter-Strike 2 profile: when it applies, vibrance at 200% with Override, contrast and brightness.
